title: AdProducer: Towards Agentic Advertising Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have made automated advertising production increasingly feasible. However, an effective advertisement must faithfully represent the product and communicate its selling points through compelling visual storytelling, which requires more than visual synthesis: it calls for deeper product understanding and strategic decisions about how to present product value. Crucially, product research and creative design are closely intertwined, as the information gathered about a product determines which features can be faithfully demonstrated and how they should be presented. In this paper, we introduce AdProducer, the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video creation, transforming concise creative briefs into finished advertisements. translated_title: AdProducer：迈向智能体驱动的广告视频生成
translated_abstract: 视频生成技术的最新进展使得自动化广告制作日益可行。然而，一条有效的广告必须忠实地呈现产品，并通过引人入胜的视觉叙事传达其卖点，这不仅需要视觉合成能力，更需要对产品的深入理解，以及关于如何展示产品价值的策略性决策。至关重要的是，产品调研与创意设计紧密交织，因为所收集到的产品信息决定了哪些特性能够被忠实地展示，以及这些特性应当如何呈现。在本文中，我们提出了 AdProducer，这是首个用于广告视频创作的端到端智能体框架，能够将简洁的创意简报转化为成品广告。我们的多模态智能体通过网络搜索与图像搜索自主开展产品调研，并将调研结果转化为以卖点为导向的分镜脚本，用于指导……
tldr: AdProducer 是首个端到端的智能体广告视频生成框架，它通过自主开展产品调研并将结果转化为以卖点驱动的分镜脚本，从而将简洁的创意简报直接转化为成品广告。
en_tdlr: AdProducer is the first end-to-end agentic framework for advertising video generation, which autonomously researches products via web and image search and turns creative briefs into selling-point-driven storyboards to produce finished advertisements.
